newsHighlights.title: Country on track for holiday travel boom
newsHighlights.summary: China is on track for a holiday travel boom as millions of people hit the road during the National Day break.
newsHighlights.translation: 国庆假期期间，数以百万计的民众踏上旅途，中国正迎来一波假日出行高峰。

newsHighlights.title: China's railway passenger trips hit record single-day high
newsHighlights.summary: China's railway passenger trips hit a record single-day high as holiday travelers flooded stations across the country.
newsHighlights.translation: 随着假日旅客涌入全国各地车站，中国铁路单日旅客发送量创下历史新高。

newsHighlights.title: At 4,000 meters, 80-year-old couple retraces the Long March
newsHighlights.summary: An 80-year-old couple retraced part of the Long March at an altitude of 4,000 meters, blending travel with red heritage.
newsHighlights.translation: 一对八旬夫妇在海拔4000米处重走长征路，把旅行与红色文化遗产结合起来。

newsHighlights.title: Travel surges on China's National Day holiday as tourists hit the road
newsHighlights.summary: Tourist numbers surged across China during the National Day holiday, with popular destinations reporting heavy crowds.
newsHighlights.translation: 国庆假期期间中国游客数量激增，热门目的地人潮涌动。

newsHighlights.title: Chinese restaurant brands rethink recipe for US market
newsHighlights.summary: Chinese restaurant brands are rethinking their recipe for the US market, mixing nostalgic flavors with local tastes.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国餐饮品牌正在重新思考进入美国市场的策略，把怀旧风味与当地口味相融合。

quote.quote: The world is a book and those who do not travel read only one page.
quote.author: Saint Augustine
quote.translation: 世界是一本书，不旅行的人只读了其中一页。
quote.explanation: 这句话强调旅行是拓宽视野、理解不同文化的方式。今天的新闻中，无论是重走长征路的老夫妇，还是奔赴各地的假日游客，都在用脚步翻开世界这本书的更多篇章。

pattern.pattern: be on track for sth. / to do sth.（有望……；正朝着……方向发展）
pattern.example: China is on track for a holiday travel boom as millions of people hit the road.
pattern.translation: 随着数百万人踏上旅途，中国正迎来假日出行高峰。
pattern.usage: on track 表示“在正常轨道上、有望达成”，常与 for + 名词 或 to do 连用，用于描述趋势或目标进展顺利。反义表达为 off track。例：The project is on track to be finished by December.

grammar.title: as 引导的时间/原因状语从句
grammar.explanation: as 可以表示“当……时”，强调两个动作同时发生；也可以表示“由于”，说明原因。新闻标题和导语中常以 as 从句交代背景，使句子紧凑。判断时可结合语境：从句动作与主句动作同时进行时多为“当……时”，解释主句原因时则为“由于”。
examples: Travel surges on China's National Day holiday as tourists hit the road.
Railway stations added extra trains as passenger trips hit a record single-day high.

pronunciation.tips: 注意结尾的 /dʒ/，由 /d/ 与 /ʒ/ 快速连读而成，不要读成 /s/ 或 /tʃ/；元音为长音 /ɜː/，口型自然放松，类似“色尔奇”。重音在唯一音节上，读得干脆有力。
examples: Travel surged across the country during the National Day holiday.
The city saw a surge of visitors along the Long March route.

reading.title: Hitting the Road: China's National Day Travel Boom
reading.content: As the National Day holiday arrived, millions of Chinese travelers hit the road, and the country is on track for a record travel boom. Railway stations across the nation reported a single-day record high in passenger trips, with extra trains added to popular routes. For many families, the holiday is not only about sightseeing but also about heritage. At an altitude of 4,000 meters, an 80-year-old couple retraced part of the Long March, turning a hard journey into a moving history lesson. Meanwhile, Chinese restaurant brands are rethinking their recipe for the US market, blending nostalgic flavors with local tastes. Whether people travel far or stay close to home, the holiday shows how culture and travel are closely connected. Every trip, short or long, helps us turn one more page of the world's great book.
reading.translation: 随着国庆假期到来，数以百万计的中国游客踏上旅途，全国正迎来一波创纪录的出行高峰。各地车站单日旅客发送量创下历史新高，热门线路加开了列车。对许多家庭而言，假期不只是观光，也与文化传承有关。在海拔4000米处，一对八旬夫妇重走了一段长征路，把艰苦的旅程变成了一堂生动的历史课。与此同时，中国餐饮品牌正在重新思考进入美国市场的策略，把怀旧风味与当地口味相融合。无论远行还是近游，这个假期都表明文化与旅行紧密相连。每一段旅程，无论长短，都帮助我们翻开世界这本大书的新的一页。
reading.sourceNote: 本文改写自 ChinaDaily「Country on track for holiday travel boom」「At 4,000 meters, 80-year-old couple retraces the Long March」「Chinese restaurant brands rethink recipe for US market」及 CGTN「China's railway passenger trips hit record single-day high」等报道，仅用于英语学习。
